topic: Wealth Decentralization and Economic Concentration Reform Ideas

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 39(b) and 39(c)
findings.limitations: Directive principles of state policy; requires statutory legislative implementation.

findings.title: Competition Act, 2002
findings.limitations: Focuses on single-market abuse; lacks conglomerate cross-sector anti-trust unbundling provisions.

gaps: Repeal of Wealth Tax Act 1957 in 2015 and Estate Duty Act 1953 in 1985 leaves wealth accumulation un-levied at capital level.
Lack of formal framework for employee ownership trusts and sovereign citizen wealth funds.
